title: Add rename check all control
summary: Added a Check All control to the Rename preview/apply toolbar and fixed manual checkbox selection so the checkbox input and its cell reliably toggle selectable preview rows. Selection still keeps blocked, duplicate-target, and existing-destination rows out of apply scope.
reason: Operators could clear all checked rename rows but had no symmetric control for checking all selectable rows after preview. The row checkbox path also needed explicit click handling so manual selection works in the WebView table.
behavior_before: Rename preview offered Check Applicable and Clear Checks only. Check Applicable selected ready/match rows and skipped warning/review rows, so operators had to manually check those rows one at a time.
behavior_after: Rename preview offers Check All next to Check Applicable. Check All selects all rows that can be applied, reports skipped blockers, updates apply readiness, and preserves backend-owned apply planning. Manual checkbox clicks and checkbox-cell clicks now update the checked-row apply scope.
tests_added: Updated backend-served WebView and Tauri scaffold tests to assert the button/export wiring.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_rename_smoke.py to click the Check All button and manual row checkbox controls in a real browser-backed Rename smoke.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_rename_readiness_smoke.py to cover Check All selection of ready plus warning rows and manual checkbox/cell toggling.
